question: The verdict vocabulary has no term for a listing that serves no object (PourCeSoir lists releases and says NZB files cannot be downloaded there; fails-egress was used) and limits[].kind has no term for a paywall that sets the free allowance to zero (nzbwolf; request-rate was used) or for an origin that times out (findnzb). Do these need terms?
why: Forced values would misstate the finding; the records name the true condition in their text.
